# T-2: Isolate gate output repair

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move invalid provider output to a two-call tooling repair path with provable cache freshness and typed root-cause evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3 permits at most one fresh repair and records provider/cache call counts.
- R4 returns tooling/provider classification without semantic retry exhaustion.
- R9 keeps non-repair cache keys, behavior, and metrics unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Add an internal agent cache policy consumed only by the repair call. Model attempt evidence and terminal protocol failure with classes that enforce non-empty phase, error, cache outcome, and classification invariants.

## Test Strategy
Extend agent cache and gate retry tests for initial cache hit, repair bypass, unavailable freshness, invalid repair exhaustion, primary-cause preservation, and unchanged normal cache metrics.
